paper.title: Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition
paper.method_summary: Hodge Spectral Duality combines discrete differential forms for topological modes with a hybrid Eulerian–Lagrangian representation of local geometric dynamics, retaining physical invariants via Hodge-orthogonal splitting.
paper.limitations: Evaluated on geometric graph benchmarks; general 3D unstructured industrial PDEs, strict cross-PDE zero-shot extrapolation and solver cost are not uniformly established.
paper.notes: Existing preprint arXiv:2605.13834 upgraded after direct PMLR ICML 2026 proceedings matching title and all three authors; PMLR volume online date is 2026-09-29.

paper.title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
paper.method_summary: A prior-data fitted Transformer approximates posterior predictive means of PDE solution fields from diverse low-cost, noisy PINN-generated priors; supports in-context solution queries without online gradient updates.
paper.limitations: In-context zero-gradient-update prediction is distinct from zero-shot cross-PDE transfer without prior conditioning; broader high-dimensional strongly coupled PDE transfer, uncertainty calibration and conservation remain to be tested.
paper.notes: Previously pending NeurIPS 2026 acceptance is now independently confirmed by the NeurIPS official 2026 Downloads paper list. This establishes accepted only, not published; publication_date is null.

paper.title: Efficient Generative Transformer Operators For Million-Point PDEs
paper.method_summary: ECHO combines hierarchical convolutional encode/decode with approximately 100-fold spatiotemporal compression and generative full-trajectory-segment modeling to limit autoregressive drift on million-point PDE simulations.
paper.limitations: Trajectory-segment sampling is not proof of arbitrary-time continuous queries; large compression ratios must be checked for high-frequency conservation and OOD dynamics.
paper.notes: Existing arXiv:2512.04974 preprint matched to NeurIPS 2026 official Downloads list; accepted, not formally published, so no publication date or DOI asserted.

paper.title: CoupledFlow: One-Step Neural Operators for Coupled Multi-Physics PDEs
paper.method_summary: Uses structure-constrained flow matching and posterior multi-output-GP correlated conditional interpolants to learn process-specific mean velocity fields conditioned on the coupled multi-physics state; derives a mean-flow consistency identity and a Wasserstein-2 distributional bound.
paper.limitations: One-step in the title must not be conflated with all-time trajectory-query guarantees; tested multi-physics benchmark coverage and conservation under out-of-distribution coupling need direct audit.
paper.notes: New stable arXiv identity 2611.10945 matched exactly to official NeurIPS 2026 accepted-paper list; no proceedings publication asserted.

paper.title: Derivative-Informed Training of Neural Operators On-the-Fly via Sketched Tangent Consistency
paper.method_summary: Sketched tangent consistency losses enforce sensitivity-residual consistency from known differentiable PDE residuals during neural-operator training, with operator-aware conditioning for stiff or saddle-point tangent systems.
paper.limitations: Requires a known differentiable residual and computationally manageable tangent operator; not a standalone PDE foundation model, and coupled stiff systems may require careful preconditioning.
paper.notes: New stable arXiv:2609.32797; exact title appears in NeurIPS 2026 official Downloads. Accepted only; official proceedings publication date unknown.

paper.title: TINNs: Time-Induced Neural Networks for Solving Time-Dependent PDEs
paper.method_summary: Time-conditioned network parameter trajectory theta(t) makes the effective spatial representation evolve continuously; Levenberg–Marquardt optimization handles PDE residual and IC/BC nonlinear least squares.
paper.limitations: PINN per-instance solving is not a pretrained operator mapping initial conditions to trajectories; reported gains should not be read as universal PDE foundation-model performance.
paper.notes: New arXiv:2601.20361 formal identity corroborated with PMLR ICML 2026 proceedings; published online 2026-09-29.

paper.title: OpInf-LLM: Parametric PDE Solving with LLMs via Operator Inference
generalization_axes: LLM tool use with reduced-order dynamics
paper.method_summary: Uses parameter-dependent operator inference and low-rank reduced-order dynamics plus an LLM tool interface for natural-language specification and execution of parametric PDE solves.
paper.limitations: Requires task-family solution data to infer operators, and reduced-order integration is not a zero-shot solver across arbitrary PDEs; numerical accuracy needs independent benchmark verification.
paper.notes: New stable arXiv:2602.01493 formally matched to NeurIPS 2026 official Downloads; status accepted only, no formal proceedings date asserted.
